No arm is expected to set a new pool minimum or exceed teacher pIC50. data.public_memory: v12 teacher 5nn4_SC2_A_1017__top2. Condition = protein-fixed mean-of-per-candidate terminal core RMSD over atoms [0,1,4,5,6,7,8,9]; function = mean pIC50 gap to teacher 7.412205; band = pool minimum 1.901513 + 0.02 -> [1.901513,1.921513], descriptive only. All groups 25/25 valid. Executed low-early family: [1,1,9,9] 1.911257/3.203184; [1,1,7,7] 1.912104/3.203108; [1,1,3,3] 1.913781/3.202891; [1,0,3,3] 1.914120/3.202795; [1,2,7,7] 1.911723/3.203156; [2,1,7,7] 1.917292/3.220583; [2,2,9,9] 1.916213/3.220687. High-early condition-best/function-worst: [7,7,7,7] 1.901513/3.284144; top10 ~5.308 vs low-early ~5.439; best pIC50 remains below teacher in all groups. Supported: low-early optimum is interior near 1 and broad; early=0 is retired/out of band (1.928420 at late3, 1.926747 at late7); symmetric early=2 is dominated at late3 and late9. Early-interval asymmetry now has direct evidence: [1,2,7,7] beats [2,1,7,7] by ~0.00557 A condition and ~0.01743 gap at late=7, so the extra early tick is more useful in interval 1 (25 guided updates) than interval 0 (16). Late amplitude 1-9 is a weak same-signed condition slope: [1,1,7,7]->[1,1,9,9] -0.000847 A with +0.000076 gap; early3 7->9 ~-0.000895 A with +0.000107 gap; functionally near-neutral, not load-bearing. Delivery is unclipped and proportional (clip_factor 1.0, clipped_fraction 0.0); cumulative correction ~1e-3 A against ~2 A residual; mean core RMSD 3.79 at step25, 2.84 at step50, ~1.91 terminal; final 91-99 window carries zero guidance. Only terminal means count; step50 gains without terminal gains are downstream erasure. Condition/function conflict is a high-early attribute, not a general early-amplitude tradeoff; low early improves both axes versus early3, while high early buys ~0.010 A condition at ~0.081 worse mean gap and lower top10. Small differences within low-early (~0.0001-0.003 A condition, ~0.0001-0.017 gap) are not stable rankings and must be reported with medians/win rates. Supplied-set duplication: G1:H1 = G3:H2 = [1,2,9,9]; G3:H1 [2,1,7,7] and G2:H2 [1,2,7,7] were executed as round-5 anchors. Only five distinct eligible arrays remain: [1,2,9,9], [2,1,9,9], [1,1,9,7], [1,0,5,5], [2,0,3,3]. No remaining candidate has a demonstrated path to beat [1,1,9,9] or the [1,0,3,3] functional tie; archive selections are G3:H2, G2:H1, G4:H1, G4:H2, with G1:H1 duplicate and G1:H2 low-value. Gaps: no late 9->10 arm supplied, no late single-interval change anchored at [1,1,9,9], no inner late point between 9 and 10, and no further sampling budget. Do not read small/null responses as guidance inertness, clipping, saturation, equivalence, or a success/stopping threshold.

data.population_diagnosis: Round 5 latest [1,0,3,3] reached terminal mean core RMSD 1.914120 A and mean affinity gap 3.202795, 25/25 valid. It is inside the pool-anchored band [1.901513,1.921513] set by [7,7,7,7] 1.901513 A, not a threshold or stopping rule. Versus [1,1,3,3] 1.913781/3.202891 and [0,0,3,3] 1.928420/3.208618, interval1=0 preserves the low-early functional advantage while costing only 0.000339 A condition, and interval0=1 is necessary because early=0 worsens both axes. The low-early functional tie remains narrow: [1,1,9,9] 1.911257/3.203184 has the best condition in that family, while [1,0,3,3] has the best observed gap by 0.000096. Delivery remains unclipped and residual-dominated, so only terminal means count. No sampling rounds remain; the two proposals are archive-only local tests at the asymmetric anchor.
data.memory_update: Final round, no further sampling. Retain [1,0,3,3] as the in-band functional reference and [1,1,9,9] as the condition-best low-early schedule. Retire early=0 as a lower floor; symmetric early=2 is dominated at late=3. Late amplitude remains a weak same-signed condition slope through 9, functionally near-neutral, and is not evidence of guidance inertness. Archive [1,0,5,5] to test late 3->5 at interval1=0, and [2,0,3,3] to bracket interval0 at 2 with interval1 held at 0. Do not treat either as executed or as a new sampling request. jobs.direction: Increase late intervals 2-3 from 3 to 5 while holding the asymmetric early pair [1,0].
jobs.exploration_degree: Local two-interval +2 step; within the default double-tick cap; no range probe because zero remain.
jobs.hypothesis: If late guidance is still weakly beneficial at interval1=0, raising intervals 2-3 to 5 should lower terminal mean core RMSD slightly without leaving the band; if late amplitude is effectively null or assignment-dominated, terminal mean will be flat and mean affinity gap unchanged.
jobs.expected_mean_effect: Condition about -0.001 to -0.003 A versus [1,0,3,3] 1.914120 A, still inside [1.901513,1.921513]; mean affinity gap near 3.2028 with a small +0.0001 possible.
jobs.expected_best_effect: Best and top10 essentially unchanged; no new Best above teacher 7.412205 expected.
jobs.falsifier: A terminal condition change smaller than about 0.001 A with paired median near zero, or a gap worsening above 0.001 without condition gain, supports a late null and retires this late edge at interval1=0; a band exit would show excessive late pressure.
jobs.diagnostic_alternative: A flat response could be a sensitivity floor from ~1e-3 A cumulative correction against a ~2 A residual, or assignment branches, not evidence that guidance is inert or clipped.
jobs.expected_subgroup_response: High-residual candidates may shift most; the paired median and win rate can stay near zero while the mean changes slightly.
jobs.revision_from_previous_result: Late amplitude through 9 was a weak same-signed condition slope at early=1 and early=3. Latest [1,0,3,3] adds an interval1=0 anchor, making a late-upper contrast informative without changing early.
jobs.expected_condition_effect: Small decrease or flat terminal mean core RMSD.
jobs.expected_functional_effect: Near-neutral; a small worsening if late pressure costs function.
jobs.scale_reason: Two late intervals each move +2 from the [1,0,3,3] anchor; this uses the allowed two changed intervals and the default two-tick cap, with no verified large-step direction and no range probes remaining.
